1: // Simple Space Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas not found
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
9: 
10:   // Ship definition
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: width / 2,
13:     y: height / 2,
14:     radius: 10,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     speed: 2,
17:     vx: 0,
18:     vy: 0,
19:     fuel: 100, // percent
20:   };
21: 
22:   // Asteroid pool
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   const maxAsteroids = 30;
25: 
26:   // Score (seconds survived)
27:   let startTime = performance.now();
28:   let score = 0;
29:   let gameOver = false;
30: 
31:   // Helper: distance between two points
32:   const dist = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => Math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1);
33: 
34:   // Spawn an asteroid from a random edge
35:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
36:     const size = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
37:     let x, y, vx, vy;
38:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
39:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
40:     if (edge === 0) { // top
41:       x = Math.random() * width;
42:       y = -size;
43:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
44:       vy = speed;
45:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
46:       x = width + size;
47:       y = Math.random() * height;
48:       vx = -speed;
49:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
50:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
51:       x = Math.random() * width;
52:       y = height + size;
53:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
54:       vy = -speed;
55:     } else { // left
56:       x = -size;
57:       y = Math.random() * height;
58:       vx = speed;
59:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
60:     }
61:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: size });
62:   };
63: 
64:   // Steering: click/tap sets ship angle toward pointer
65:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
66:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
67:     const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
68:     const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
69:     ship.angle = Math.atan2(my - ship.y, mx - ship.x);
70:     ship.vx = Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
71:     ship.vy = Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
72:   });
73: 
74:   const update = (dt) => {
75:     if (gameOver) return;
76: 
77:     // Move ship (drift)
78:     ship.x += ship.vx;
79:     ship.y += ship.vy;
80: 
81:     // Wrap ship around edges
82:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
83:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
84:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height;
85:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
86: 
87:     // Reduce fuel
88:     ship.fuel -= dt * 0.01; // fuel per ms
89:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) ship.fuel = 0;
90: 
91:     // Update asteroids
92:     asteroids.forEach(a => {

94:       a.y += a.vy;

97:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

118:     // Update score

159:   };
160: 
161:   let last = performance.now();
162:   const loop = () => {
163:     const now = performance.now();

168:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);

170:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
